overview: Guatemala is a country in Central America, south of Mexico. Its capital, Guatemala City, is the largest city in Central America. Guatemala was at the heart of the ancient Maya civilisation, and ruined cities such as Tikal can still be visited. Many Guatemalans today are Maya and speak Mayan languages as well as Spanish.

geography.text: A chain of volcanoes runs through Guatemala's highlands, some of them still active, such as Volcán de Fuego. Lake Atitlán, ringed by volcanoes, is one of the most famous lakes in the Americas. The north, called Petén, is lowland covered in tropical forest, and the country has coasts on both the Pacific and the Caribbean.
